web-guide-idea-48.audience: Adults who want patient help with everyday phone tasks.
web-guide-idea-48.offer: Offer unhurried guidance at the person’s pace. Choose one task and let them repeat it until comfortable.
web-guide-idea-48.steps.0: Ask which device and task they need help with.
web-guide-idea-48.steps.1: Explain each step without taking control of sensitive accounts.
web-guide-idea-48.steps.2: Let them repeat the task and make a simple reminder note.
web-guide-idea-48.equipment: A phone for the call; a second device or family helper may make practising easier.
web-guide-idea-48.returnReason: People may return for another task when they trust your patience and clear explanations.
web-guide-idea-48.promotion: Introduce yourself with a simple demonstration. Do not request passwords, payment codes or remote access to banking.

web-guide-idea-48.metadataDescription: Patiently explain video calls, photo backups, accessibility settings and everyday apps. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
